# Error-code snapshot. Each line pins an error->code
# (or error->error-taxonomy) mapping that MUST stay identical.
# Format: [section] headers, then `key = value` lines compared exactly.
[cryptoCode]
CryptoFailed = CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
CryptoUnsupported = CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID
CryptoBadKey = CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
CryptoAuthFailed = CKR_ENCRYPTED_DATA_INVALID
[denyInit]
unknown-mech = CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID
conflict = CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE
key-required = CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD
# bad-handle: an unknown key handle at keyed init is CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID
# (PKCS#11 v3.1 section 5.1.6; the init return lists in 5.8.1, 5.10.1,
# 5.13.1 and 5.15.1 carry it, not CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID).
bad-handle = CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID
[denyReason]
unknown-mech = unknown mechanism
conflict = an operation is already active in this slot
key-required = operation requires a key
bad-handle = unknown key handle
